## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Model-driven image generation (tools, ~8h, HIGH)

- **What**: Cline #13025 "feat(llms): add model-driven image generation" (merged 2026-08-15). Comprehensive image generation support: added `capabilities: ["image-generation"]` to model catalog, SDK model capability validation (`modelSupportsToolCalling` gate treats populated capability list without "tools" as authoritative), image generation model routing, streaming image responses, runtime tool ownership preservation, desktop image relay for attached hub sessions, model catalog regeneration with image-gen models, capability passthrough at catalog boundary (toSdkModelInfo / adaptSdkModelInfo preserve SDK capability list verbatim, union user overrides without fabricating from overrides alone, emit explicit "tools" signal when none survived), shared `modelHasCapability(model, capability, {assumeWhenUnspecified})` helper (missing/empty lists carry no signal, each check declares default). Fix: VS Code round-trips model metadata through legacy ModelInfo shape; toSdkModelInfo was reconstructing capability arrays from legacy booleans alone (no "tools" projection), every model came back as "cannot call tools", sessions registered zero tools, file-edit e2e failed (editor tool resolved to "Unknown tool"). Verified: file-edit e2e (Single Root + Multi-Roots) passes locally.
- **Why**: Alexi has NO image generation capability (no tool, no model routing, no capability validation). Cline's #13025 adds comprehensive image-gen: model catalog declares `capabilities: ["image-generation"]`, SDK validates and routes, streaming image responses work, desktop relays images. Users increasingly expect multi-modal output (code + diagrams, UI mockups, data visualizations). Alexi's SAP AI Core providers support image-gen models (Anthropic Claude can generate, Gemini has Imagen, Stable Diffusion deployments available). HIGH priority: adds new user-facing capability (image generation on demand), requires model catalog extension + capability validation + streaming support + tool/command interface, ~8h (capability schema + model catalog updates + streaming image handler + command/tool wrapper + tests). Proven pattern from Cline's comprehensive implementation.
- **Source**: Cline PR #13025 "feat(llms): add model-driven image generation" (merged 2026-08-15). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13025. Adds image generation support with model capabilities, validation, streaming, SDK catalog integration, desktop relay, capability passthrough fix.
- **Category**: tools (image generation). **Size**: ~8h. **Priority**: HIGH (new user-facing capability, proven pattern, SAP AI Core supports image-gen models).

#### 2. Voice transcription input (tools, ~6h, CONSIDER)

- **What**: Cline #13023 "feat(desktop): add microphone transcription input" (merged 2026-08-15). Desktop app microphone input with voice transcription: added voice input UI, transcription model routing (`scope voice transcription models`, `defer chat model filtering`), batch transcript guard (invalidate stale streaming transcripts, preserve batch transcription lifecycle), model catalog refresh for voice models, mic icon UI, speech input icon assertions in tests. Allows users to speak prompts instead of typing.
- **Why**: Alexi CLI has NO voice input (text-only interface). Cline's #13023 adds microphone transcription for desktop app: speak prompts, transcription models route audio→text, batch lifecycle guards stale streams. Voice input improves accessibility and speed (speaking faster than typing for long prompts). Pattern is portable to CLI (record audio, stream to transcription model, inject as text prompt). SAP AI Core likely supports Whisper or similar transcription models. CONSIDER priority: valuable UX improvement but desktop-focused (CLI voice input requires audio capture + streaming, less common workflow for terminal users), ~6h (audio capture via node module + transcription model routing + streaming lifecycle + CLI integration + tests). Proven pattern but medium-priority for CLI tool.
- **Source**: Cline PR #13023 "feat(desktop): add microphone transcription input" (merged 2026-08-15). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13023. Desktop microphone transcription with model routing, batch guard, lifecycle management.
- **Category**: tools (voice input). **Size**: ~6h. **Priority**: CONSIDER (valuable UX but desktop-focused, CLI audio capture less common, medium priority).

#### 3. Streaming markdown block reuse optimization (core, ~3h, CONSIDER)

- **What**: Cline #13248 "fix(cli): stop streaming markdown from flashing raw text on every chunk" (merged 2026-08-15). TUI markdown rendering fix: render assistant markdown with `internalBlockMode="top-level"` so each top-level markdown block gets own renderable (default coalesced mode merged entire message into one block, rebuilt and re-highlighted on every streamed chunk, flashing settled headings and links back to raw uncolored markdown - visible ###, unconcealed syntax - until async tree-sitter highlight landed, re-wrapping rows so transcript jumped vertically). Top-level blocks reused by token identity, settled content never re-renders, only trailing unstable block updates per chunk. Pass `tableOptions style=grid` to keep bordered table rendering coalesced mode used by default.
- **Why**: Alexi TUI (Ink-based, `src/cli/tui/`, `src/cli/interactive.ts`) likely has same streaming markdown rendering issue: if markdown is re-parsed/re-highlighted on every chunk, settled content flashes raw text until highlight resolves, transcript jumps vertically. Cline's #13248 fixes with `internalBlockMode="top-level"` (block-level reuse by token identity, only unstable trailing block re-renders). CONSIDER priority: UX polish (smoother streaming, less flash), but requires investigation of Alexi's current markdown rendering (if already using marked/marked-terminal per 032-tui-exact-clone, may have same issue or may differ), ~3h (verify current render path, apply block-reuse pattern if applicable, test streaming stability). Proven fix but needs confirmation Alexi has the problem.
- **Source**: Cline PR #13248 "fix(cli): stop streaming markdown from flashing raw text on every chunk" (merged 2026-08-15). Full PR at https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/13248. TUI render optimization: internalBlockMode="top-level" stops flash-to-raw on every chunk.
- **Category**: core (TUI rendering). **Size**: ~3h. **Priority**: CONSIDER (UX polish, needs verification Alexi has the issue).
